name: Hosaka Miyuki
source:
Miyuki lives in Kanazawa (金沢), Ishikawa and goes to Sayama High School (茶山高校), where she's a third year student in class B.

She likes to go to museums to look at paintings and Japanese art, doesn't like to wear kimonos. Her favorite subjects in school are world history and math.
